title: asplenium haurakiense
intro: Asplenium haurakiense, commonly known as the Hauraki fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. It is native to New Zealand and is traditionally used in Maori medicine for its healing properties. The health benefits of Asplenium haurakiense include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
